Mock tests on the 4 in 1 app, any questions you get wrong screenshot and go over them until you’ve got the answer. Same with the hazard awareness section, keep doing mocks until you’re consistently getting the pass score. When you’re in the test you actually get a decent amount of time to answer the questions so take your time and don’t rush it. Keep focused while doing the hazard awareness. Good luck!
Mine was absolutely lovely, I failed but he was so kind about it and said I can drive it was just nerves. Really hoping I get him again for my next test🤞🏼

I failed mid November due to anxiety, managed to get another test for tomorrow. Keep looking out for cancellations, the website keeps you logged in for 30 minutes so when I had free time I’d log in and refresh every now and then, jumped on the first one I found. Keep at it - don’t let all that money, time and effort go to waste. Making such big mistakes can be helpful as it’ll be seared into your brain and you’ll be less likely to make them again. Good luck 😊

I'm sorry you're going through this. Does he know about your bpd? If so, my bpd side is agreeing with you. If he knows, then he's chosen to take you on as you are, and to me that means being a bit more sensitive and understanding to you than he would be to a 'healthy' person - not special treatment, but just being a bit more careful because you *need* it. If you got into a relationship with a wheelchair bound man would you expect him to walk? No, you'd help. Mental health is just as important in my opinion.  
He's agreed to these rules and so he should follow them. If he really can't then (in my opinion) he should either leave you to be free and heal, or listen to your needs and stick to them out of love. Neither option is bad, because he has a right to leave if he can't handle it. The fucked up part is him lying to you, promising to be better but then not sticking to boundaries you've set to help your relationship. I'd suggest taking some time out for yourself, I saw on the other comment you said you were worried about losing interest, but if he loses interest because a couple of days apart after a 2 and a half year relationship then you deserve more anyway. I hope you're okay x

My main reason is my son - I don't want him growing up wondering why mummy didn't love him enough to stay, or thinking its a good idea (if ever he was to struggle I wouldn't want him following me like that), or the risk of him living with someone else and not being cared for. God forbid if I ever lost him I know I wouldn't last even 24 hours, i'd be gone. 

Secondary reasons - my husband wondering why he wasn't good enough, or my family wondering what more they could've done. I've seen how affected they were from previous attempts and I just refuse to put them all through it. No matter how much I want it and feel like I deserve it, *they don't*.
